title: WR-90 with walls of 1e6 S/m, 200 mm, by the time-domain solver: TE10 attenuation over the band
source: TE10 conductor attenuation α_c = R_s(2bπ² + a³k²)/(a³bβkη) (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, eq. 3.96), R_s = √(ωμ0/2σ), σ = 1e6 S/m: 0.12945, 0.09503 and 0.08592 Np/m at 8, 10 and 12 GHz, |S21| = e^{−α_c L}, evaluated separately from EMCraft's code

quantities.quantity: |S21| at 8 GHz (dB): the loss of 200 mm
quantities.reason: the surface-impedance condition on 1 mm cells, second order: measured +0.3, +0.3 and +0.55 % (−0.4, +0.8 and +2.3 % at 1.5 mm); the transforms settle to 1e-5, which leaves |S21| within some 1e-4 near the cut-off; the closed form is itself first order in R_s/η (k/β)² ≈ 1.5e-3
a uniform guide: the incident run is the same guide, so only the lossy mode's difference from the lossless one, of order R_s/η, could reflect
